accessibility: NO QUOTES RECEIVED YET: budget total_eur of 0 is a placeholder, not a price. Itemised VAT-inclusive quotes are needed from the venue, caterer, coach operator and AV/band supplier. The hard cap is EUR 18,500 incl. VAT (about EUR 132 a head). The coordinator's suggestion to quote around 5% (about EUR 900) below the cap is a suggestion only. Nothing is to be booked until the client has seen the quotes. The band is to be quoted as a separate line.

Written venue confirmation still needed that these are step-free: drop-off and parking to the entrance, terrace (surface and thresholds), Long Gallery, dining room, accessible toilets, route to keynote seating. No link has yet been reported as non-step-free.

Long Gallery rain fallback: ask the venue to confirm the hold now, the switch time and the cut-off. The decision is by midday on Wed 18 Nov, based on the forecast. The Long Gallery must be step-free and catering, bar and AV must be able to follow.

CAPACITY FLAG: a standard coach seats about 49 to 57, so one coach cannot carry more than 90 guests. The second-coach threshold of 90 needs checking with the client. Quote actual seat counts. Suggested transport RSVP cut-off is about 5 Nov. Ask about cancellation terms on a provisional second coach.
At least one coach must be wheelchair-accessible with a lift or ramp. The pick-up point must be step-free. Driver contact details are needed.
Coach departure at 23:15 is assumed to hold even if dinner slips. This is UNCONFIRMED.

Keynote start time is not yet confirmed (ends 20:30). The keynote is livestreamed: confirm wired connectivity, power, a backup connection and who runs the stream. If the keynote overruns, dinner is delayed and the talk is never cut. Ask the caterer and venue how much delay the kitchen can absorb (e.g. up to 30 minutes).

Caterer to provide: a written menu with full allergen declarations, cross-contamination procedures (stocks, sauces, garnishes, shared fryers and prep surfaces; watch oyster sauce, shrimp paste, seafood stock), and confirmation that serving staff are briefed. The vegan dishes must be distinct dishes. There are 118 standard portions.
Reception is alcohol-free. Plan soft drinks, mocktails, tea and coffee. Wine is fine with dinner.
The venue and caterer must know the emergency procedure for an allergy incident.
